fields.label: Description
fields.value: Photograph caption dated September 5, 1948 reads, "Walt Disney, right, is shown presenting a picture to State Forester M. B. Pratt, to be used as a fire prevention poster for the State Division of Forestry in its drive to reduce forest fires in California."  The poster reads "Dont' be a firebug!  A careless fire is sabotage," and features a cartoon character driving a car and carelessly throwing a cigarette onto forest grounds.
